# Finish Demo B's interaction and tour host composition

## Context

This is the remaining control-host slice of #15614. The gesture, perspective and native-effects slices are merged in `dev 185b025515`; with the restored pane-title metadata, its host measures 1,890 raw / 943 code lines. The [earlier integration receipt](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/15614#issuecomment-6701780682) preserves the merge traps. Current candidate `828dcd321b` measures 1,498 raw / 690 code lines and retains the composition/projection/facade boundary; merged-final acceptance remains open.

## The Problem

Two demo-specific responsibilities remain scattered through that host:
- Eight interaction-bridge methods: preview/local-terminal callbacks and the remote transfer's deferred continuity receipt, 234 method lines.
- Seven tour-presentation/cue methods: controls, captions, progress and cue forwarding, 77 method lines.

They have different reasons to change and should have separate module homes. Delivering these two small moves together uses the same workspace/tour/native acceptance set and avoids another standalone tiny presentation PR.

## The Architectural Reality

**Interaction family:** `commitCrossWindowTransfer`, `localDockRect`, `clearWorkspaceAffordances`, `hitTestWorkspace`, `renderWorkspacePreview`, `onDockCrossZoneDragMove`, `onDockCrossZoneDrop`, `onDockCrossZoneDragCancel`.

Stage's Participation construction already binds preview/clear/hit-test and commit together. Local drop increments the counter the remote receipt requires to remain zero; cancellation clears every workspace's affordances and settles the same gesture resolver. Group acknowledgement precedes deferred rendered-proof settlement.

**Tour family:** `createTourBar`, `onTourBeat`, `onTourComplete`, `onTourError`, `onTourScene`, `setPipProgress`, `setTourCaption`.

The runner, script identity, static `totalBeats`, `beatCount`, subscriptions/destruction and `startTour`'s atomic three-document reset remain host-owned.

Design authority: n/a — preserves existing behavior while completing the parent's maintenance/decomposition intent.

Prescription checked: the existing demo Base prototype mixins own code on the same instance. Euclid independently confirmed the eight-body bridge and keeping `onDockTearOutExit` on the host as a separate native-admission gate. The tour subset has an existing two-run native consumer.

Direct `DragAffordances` adoption is not mechanical: it owns geometry promise/signature/producer lifetime, invalidates on clear, adds candidate/empty-wrap/same-tabs guards, and its asynchronous drop forwards a descriptor. Demo B currently consumes workspace-keyed premeasured geometry and returns its local reducer result synchronously. Participation's default transfer lacks this demo's detached-pane bookkeeping, generation fence and deferred witness. Continue reusing the existing producer, contract, renderer and Participation without changing those policies.

## The Fix

Add two same-owner registered Base mixins in `examples/dashboard/crossWindow/`:
1. `DemoBCrossWindowHost.mjs` for the eight interaction implementations.
2. `DemoBTourHost.mjs` for the seven tour implementations.

Delete the moved implementations from DemoBWorkspace. Retain three small public facades with distinct internal names:
- `commitCrossWindowTransfer` supplies main/popup IDs;
- `createTourBar` supplies the script and a lazy `totalBeats` callback;
- `onTourComplete` supplies the same lazy callback, preserving the beat lookup after the current caption callback runs.

No import back to the host. All inter-method calls continue through the current host. Keep producer/maps/counters/gesture context/resolver/refresh queue, lifecycle, script/reset authority, native-admission gate and projection on the host.

## Contract Ledger

| Surface | Authority | Preserved behavior | Refusal / fallback | Docs | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Transfer facade | Current Stage/Group and host witness | Early Boolean admission, post-adoption data reread, immediate ownership bookkeeping, later fenced receipt | Existing whole-stack branch and stale-generation refusal | Method JSDoc | Existing transfer units and native cross-window journeys |
| Preview/local terminals | Existing producer/contract/Participation | Same measured maps, synchronous preview/drop result, counters and cancellation settlement | Same missing geometry/host outcomes | Method JSDoc | Existing preview/drop units and native gestures |
| Tour controls/cues | Current script, host and runner | Same configuration/text, live host cue calls and completion order | Existing error caption and missing-reference guards | Method JSDoc | Existing two-run tour plus completion-order control |
| Composition/lifetime | Current host constructor/destroy/startTour | One instance; same stores, maps, runner, reset and teardown | Existing cleanup | Class JSDoc | Existing lifecycle and rerun tests |

Decision Record impact: aligned-with `neomjs/neo#adr:docking-design`; no protocol or behavioral amendment.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: The fifteen implementations have the two named module homes; three public host facades remain, with no new state/lifecycle owner.
- [ ] AC-2: Bodies preserve behavior except explicit semantic-ID/script/beat-lookup inputs and distinct internal names. Keep admission/receipt separation, current host dispatch and lazy completion beat lookup.
- [ ] AC-3: A completion-order control passes on unchanged base and candidate; existing workspace/TourRunner and full Engine units pass without weaker expectations.
- [ ] AC-4: Existing native cross-window, perspective/tour, tear-out and pop-out consumers pass. Rehearse integration with the three reviewed slices, with a base-controlled method census and measured raw/code counts; verify the parent's raw target without moving lifecycle or projection merely for size.
- [ ] AC-5: Complete JSDoc/`@summary`, correct size baseline without an obsolete below-target exception, honest combined-growth accounting and updated parent map. Keep parent closure and merged-final matrix acceptance separate from the local rehearsal.

## Out of Scope

Changing preview/geometry/drop policy; adopting DragAffordances; changing tour content or Demo A; moving `startTour`, `totalBeats`, `onDockTearOutExit`, projection or lifecycle; new windows/targets; shared Engine/Group changes; Fleet row-4 or three-OS certification; parent closure.

## Avoided Traps

Do not combine the two responsibilities into one generic helper. Do not capture beat-count values before a current caption callback can change the script authority. Do not widen the native-admission gate into the preview bridge. Do not accept either side of a merge wholesale or retain dead method copies behind mixin overwrite. Line count is evidence of the result, not permission to change these boundaries.

## Ownership and sweeps

Sophie owns this planned parent continuation. Structural fast-path: both files share the existing example-local Base prototype-host role and directory; no new subsystem or Agent OS structure-map scope.
